natural-wooden-scented-candle.description:
Ships within 2 business days, with tracking.

A refillable scented candle in a natural beech wood shell, for the coffee table, a bedside or a shelf.

Hypsoé has made home scents in France for more than 25 years: its perfumes come from Grasse and its candles are poured with the know-how of French wax makers. The shell is turned by French artisans from a single block of solid beech grown in sustainably managed French forests: a rounded base that rises into a slight cone, like the foot of a flame. Inside sits a 200 g Hypsoé candle in its tin; when it is finished, a refill in any scent slips into the same shell.

  • Shell: 11 cm high, 9 cm across (4.3 x 3.5 in)

  • Candle: 200 g, about 40 hours of burning; the refill is 8 cm high, 6.8 cm across

  • Scents: Ambre: amber and orange blossom; Boreal: pine resin, pine needles, eucalyptus and cedar; Cachemire: oud wood, incense, patchouli and white musk; Lounge: vetiver, amber wood and sandalwood; Or Jaune: mimosa, iris, water jasmine, green leaf and heliotrope; Or Rose: powdery rose, peony, hawthorn, geranium and sandalwood; Thé Bourbon: Bourbon vanilla and tea; Velvet: cedarwood, leather, musk, patchouli and sandalwood.

  • Wax: French mineral wax enriched with vegetal wax, with a lead-free cotton wick. Made in France; the perfumes are made in Grasse.

  • Included: a cotton bag and a box of long matches

  • Care: trim the wick before lighting, keep the flame away from drafts, and never leave a lit candle unattended.
natural-wooden-scented-candle.seo_description: Refillable scented candle by Hypsoé in a solid beech shell made by hand in France. 200 g, about 40 hours, eight scents. Ships across Canada and the US.

black-table-still-candlesticks.description:
Ships within 2 business days, with tracking.

A slim black candlestick for the dining table whose flame never sinks: a spring inside lifts the candle as it burns.

Hypsoé's Still candlestick hides a spring that uncoils as the taper dwindles, keeping the flame at the rim, as if it rose straight from the steel. The shape of the base keeps it steady. Group several heights and finishes for a warm, living light.

  • Heights: 27.7 cm (10.9 in) or 23.8 cm (9.4 in); the base is 4.5 cm (1.8 in) across

  • Finish: stainless steel in black

  • Included: one candle of mineral wax enriched with vegetal wax, about 8 hours of burning, in a protective box

  • Care: never leave a lit candle unattended.
black-table-still-candlesticks.seo_description: Black Still candlestick by Hypsoé: a hidden spring keeps the flame at the rim as the candle burns. Two heights. Ships across Canada and the US.

A scented liquid soap in a 500 ml bottle, for the powder room or beside the kitchen sink.
